verdict: PASS literal PoW reward arithmetic, sequential batch and derived envelope bound

validation.evidence: Parent confirmed author targeted exit0; reviewer read exact source, cached reference reward/validation bodies and existing log without builds.
validation.axioms: Three printed exports standard only; reward_bound uses propext/Quot.sound

checks: Three base reward constants match proposed Frontier/Byzantium/Constantinople eras. minerReward performs base/32 before multiplication by ommer count; ommerReward multiplies (8-age)*base before division by8, matching archived source integer order.

Admission supplies at most two ommers and ages1..6, not an aggregate reward cap. ommer_bound derives the per-ommer 7*base/8 bound; ommer_sum inducts every entry; reward_bound combines both bonuses and checks each era against existing powMaximum with kernel arithmetic.

payments lists the canonical miner first, followed by every supplied ommer beneficiary in list order. pay executes every literal increaseBalance; equal beneficiaries/miner aliases are neither merged nor dropped.

batch proves every individual natural payment fits UInt256 from membership<=sum<=powMaximum<UInt256.size before equating amount.toNat to the intended natural amount. Exact CreditBatch accumulates the same full payment sum and actual sequential final world.

ledger adds exactly one PoW batch count and the derived natural reward sum through existing Ledger.pow, using proved batch and reward_bound. No assumed total-world wealth, batch-sum cap or reference outcome postcondition appears.
explicit_inputs: Chosen reward Era, miner and full ommer list.
Admission cardinality and ages for that list.
Existing literal funding Ledger for the initial reward world.
limitations: Admission does not itself prove canonical header/ommer ancestry, unique ommer hashes, beneficiary extraction or era/fork schedule; these remain reference producers.
Natural payment fit is proved, but checked recipient balance addition and reference TransactionState/incorporate_tx_into_block correspondence remain open.
pay uses pinned modular UInt256 credit and may lose funds on recipient overflow; the theorem binds exact credited amounts and nonincrease envelope, not checked-reference equality.

Age<=6 is retained as reference validity input even though the coarse upper-bound proof only needs age>=1. No reference unsigned subtraction equivalence is inferred solely from natural truncated subtraction.
No canonical PoW block occurrence, terminal ancestry/count, complete fork classification or protocol supply closure is proved here.
